_doc: SPECIFICATIONS section 14: the licenses build-verified by the license inventory. ci/license-gates.ts reads this record. An npm entry that is in the lockfile must match the tree (a mismatch fails); one not in the lockfile yet is printed as PENDING and is re-checked the day it lands; an npm entry names its owning task (owner), and the gate fails when that task has merged while the entry is still PENDING. An npm entry whose owning task did not take it (an SD fallback left unbuilt) is retired with its reason (F-1163): it prints RETIRED, and the gate fails if the package lands in the lockfile while the record says it does not ship. certbot is a container and MapLibre Native iOS is a Swift Package Manager package: neither is an npm package, so their SPDX IDs are recorded from upstream and cannot be tree-checked; certbot is checked by the SHA-256 of its kept license text (licenseFile) instead. A vendored entry (F-530) is a shipped file set kept in this repo, outside every package manager: its kept license text, beside the files, is hashed the same way (licenseFile is a path from ci/license/). The native map library has two licenses (SD-35: MIT and BSD), one entry each; the npm binding is the part this inventory verifies from the tree.
